title: How to Get Out of Your Comfort Zone & See the World Differently

seo_description: Babur Ayub on getting out of your comfort zone: the ChenOne story, a jute waistcoat, learning from mistakes, and seeing the world differently.
keywords: how to get out of your comfort zone

guest.name: Babur Ayub
bio: Babur Ayub has 25+ years of leadership experience in Pakistan's retail and fashion industry, including Chenone, Hang Ten, Servis Group, Imperial Stores, Khas Stores and Onieo.

He is a lecturer at STEP IADM, a startup mentor, and the author of "Management by Qur'an". He appears in Find Your Clarity, the short-episode series by Muffled Minds in which each episode takes one big question everyone is confused about and looks for clarity.

summary: In Find Your Clarity #06, host Khawar Shahzad and guest Babur Ayub talk about getting out of your comfort zone and seeing the world differently. Starting from Robert Greene's idea of taking a different route each day, Babur Ayub explains that every creature sees a different version of the same world: a dog lives by smell, a spider by vibrations, and every human has a different angle too.

Babur Ayub tells the story of his own unorthodox path: breaking away from his family's construction business, a jute waistcoat with a gold-plated button, losing his money in a stock exchange crash, selling shirts door to door, and joining ChenOne, where he went from an unwanted visitor to Operations Head Pakistan in nine months. He shows how handling difficult customers, including a lady who threw a shoe at him and a man who complained about a tie, taught him that the customer is king and that a mistake, once learned from, can be resolved.

The episode closes with the timeline of the universe: time began with the Big Bang, and the Almighty sees the whole timeline in one go. Babur Ayub argues that how we conceive God depends on our time, our literature, our background and our training, so the introduction of God keeps changing from age to age, and from person to person.

takeaways: We each see a different version of the world: a dog lives by smell, a spider by vibrations, and every human has a different angle too.
Most people plan their future on an orthodox model, copying their parents or the people around them instead of looking beyond the set pattern.
The same thing has zero value for a labourer and becomes a status symbol for a rich man; value depends on who wears it.
Money comes and goes; the one thing to take care of is that you do not owe anyone, so nobody comes to knock on your door.
An unorthodox model of your own, built from experiments, is what gets you further than copying a set pattern.
A customer is the king: when he shows a complaint, he should get a replacement, not an argument.
The guest's tie story shows how a mistake, once learned from and resolved, can bring the same angry customer back to do 80,000 rupees of shopping.
You cannot plan your achievements step by step; they are the product of your aptitude and mindset, not of a plan.
How you conceive God depends on your time, your literature, your background and your training; it changes from age to age.

transcript.text: Till the time when it crashed, and I did my original investment on the side, but the rest of the money I earned fell into it. My father said, if you have lost money, just take care of one thing, nobody should come and knock the door. To phir maine shirts banayi, shirts bana ke bechne shuru ki. Us zamane mein har roz mujhe kehte the ji ke aaj Mian Sahab aa jayenge, aur wo aise karte karte teen mahine guzar gaye. Pachas ke qareeb to mere paas wo thi, report si, maine aise table par rakhi, sir, yeh aapke shirts ka analysis, sir, yeh aapke trousers ka analysis, sir, yeh aapke ladies' garments ka, yeh, wo [unclear]. They gave me a badge in the company.

Just after a span of 9 months, I was raised to the position of Operations Head. Unhone Punjabi mein bola ke tujhe pata nahi main kaun hoon. Unhone apne bag mein se joota nikala, ladies' joota tha, aur unhone throw kiya meri taraf. You don't plan that you want to be a general manager. You just plan that you want to act like this. Assalamualaikum everyone. Welcome to Find Your Clarity Series. I'm your host, Khawar. Aur hamare saath hain hamesha ki tarah Sir Babur Ayub, salaam walekum. Walekum salaam.

Aaj ki episode ka topic hai. Abhi recently main ek podcast dekh raha tha, Robert Greene jo hai na, ek author hain, unki to wo matlab keh rahe the ke humein apni daily life mein ye jo duniya hai isko ek different angle se dekhna chahiye. Let's just say ke aapne ek destination pe jaana hai, from point A to point B, aap ek route jo hai wo select karte ho, ek route jo hai wo select karte ho, aap us pe pahunch jaate ho. Next day bhi aapne jaana hai, to try to adopt different route, ke aap thoda sa ke chale jayein.

Third day aap ek alag route jo hai wo le lein. Hoga kya? Jab aap raste se guzar rahe honge, aapke raste mein different trees aayenge, different destinations, different spots aayenge, theek hai. Aap un spots ko ek different angle se dekh rahe honge. For example aap ek tree dekhte ho. Ab tree jo hai wo to matlab jab se duniya bani hai tab se hoga na, wahan, matlab kayi trees aise bhi hain jo wahin pe hain. Ab jo tree word hai wo English se ek word hai. Wo kabhi na kabhi invent hua hoga. Theek hai, jo tree word hai.

Ab hamare zehan mein sabse pehle tree word aata hai. Ab tree word ko side pe rakh do. Ab ek cheez dekhte ho jo ke zameen se bahar nikal rahi hai, jiski roots hain, aur usmein se kuch shakhein nikal rahi hain jin pe kuch patte hain. Aap pehle roots pe gaur karte ho, phir jo uski branches hain us pe gaur karte ho, phir aap leaves pe jo hai wo uske gaur karte ho, aur matlab jisne banaya, the Almighty, ab uski creation jo hai na, us pe jo hai wo focus jo hai wo karte ho.

Ab uske accordingly, ke hum yeh jo world hai, isko ek, ek different, iska ek jo version hai na, wo hum dekh rahe hain, ek version. Ek version jo hai wo insects jo hai wo dekhti hain. Ek version jo hai wo animals dekhte hain. Ab animals jo hain, animals mein agar hum dog ki example lein, uski jo, jo wo sense hai smell karne ki, wo bohat strong hai. Ab wo smell ki base ke upar jo hai na, wo chal raha hai. Apni saari jo zindagi hai dog ki, wo smell ki base ke upar chal rahi hai. Wo ek different, is world ka ek different version jo hai wo dekh raha hai. Ab example lein agar spider ki, makdi ki example hum lete hain. Most of the jo spiders hain wo blind jo hai wo hoti hain. Ab wo kaun sa version dekh rahi hain? Wo vibrations wala version jo hai wo dekh rahi hain, ke wo movement unki kaise hoti hai, vibrations ko, earth ki vibrations, different objects ki jo vibrations hain, unki base ke upar jo hai wo chalte hain.

So jitne bhi, even hum do humans, hum jis angle se is duniya ko dekh rahe hain, hamara bhi angle different hai. Hamara bhi version different hai. Ek mera version hai, ek aapka version hai. So aap is duniya ko kis version se jo hai wo dekhte hain? Aapne itni zyada tafseelaat usmein de di hain ke main usmein gum ho gaya hoon. Lekin main usmein se nikalne ki koshish karunga, is sense mein ke jo aap zindagi mein kuch banna chahte hain, bohat saare log ek orthodox model ke upar apna future dekhte hain. Orthodox model se matlab ke main bada ho jaunga, phir maine apne parents ko dekha wo kaise the, ya grandfather ko, grandparents ko dekha, ya apne ird-gird ke kuch logon ko dekha, jin mein uthna baithna tha. To koi, koi Chaudhary ke ird-gird ke log hain to wo Chaudhary banna chahenge. Koi tanga chalane wale hain to wo kahenge ke hamara tanga achha ho. Koi businessman hai, koi construction se related hai, koi manufacturer hai, to uski, uske jo bachche hain wo usi tarah ka kuch banna chahenge.

Aam taur pe yeh dekha gaya hai ke wo usse hatke kuch nahi dekhte. Yaani jo ek set pattern unko mil jaata hai, usi tarteeb mein, usi tarkeeb mein wo apne aap ko force hi karte hain aur apna future usmein dekhte hain. Bada orthodox hamara mindset hota hai. Mera yeh khayal hai ke abhi mere parents, mere father construction ke business, mere grandfather construction ke business se related the, aur 100 years old company thi unki, yaani subcontinent ke andar unka ek naam tha, aur Pakistan Railways ke saath unhone kaam kiya itne saal. Lekin main, mujhe unhone usmein, us field mein enter hi nahi hone diya.

Main padha, maine graduation ki, uske baad maine MBA kiya, to main, yaani jab mujhe unhone usmein enter nahi hone diya, to mera, mera jo orthodox model tha, wo toot gaya. Yaani maine jab dekha ke mere paas koi model hi nahi hai. Maine, I don't want to be like my father as a businessman, because he is not in favour of the business which he is doing. Koi ird-gird ke koi jaanne wale politician se unke dost the, to I want to be a politician, ke yaar inki badi maujein lagi hui hain. Bada yeh kaam kar rahe hain aur bada inka protocol and all that. To mere paas koi orthodox model nahi tha.

To aise mein mere paas kya tha, ek playground thi aur experiments the. To main us playground ke upar aake jo experiments karna chahta tha, wo maine kiye. Yaani sabse pehle aapko zindagi mein kis cheez ki zaroorat hoti hai? Agar aap padh likh gaye hain to aapke parents, aapki family, aapke ird-gird ke log aapse expect karte hain ke yaar agar padh likh gaya to phir kaam bhi achha karega, aur kaam achha karega to paise bhi achhe kamayega. Achhe paise, achhe kamayega to lifestyle bhi iska humse behtar hoga. Ab main ek achhe lifestyle ke saath wo saari cheezein already enjoy kar chuka tha. Lekin mere paas wo kaam nahi tha jo mere father kar rahe the, mere chacha kar rahe the, mere dada kar rahe the. To maine wo experiments kiye, aur usmein bade ajeeb-o-ghareeb qism ke experiments the. Yaani ke mujhe koi guide karne wala nahi.

To main kya soch raha hoon ke maine ek dafa apne ek dost ke saath milkar program banaya ke hum jute, jute nahi hoti, ye jo jute ki boriyan banti hain, uski waistcoat banayenge. Waistcoat. Achha, aur us waistcoat ke upar jo button lagte hain, unmein se ek button gold-plated hoga. Ek button gold-plated hoga, 18 karat gold, baaki ordinary buttons honge, aur wo jute ki waistcoat hogi. Lekin yeh waistcoat bazaar mein nahi bikegi. Yeh sirf us zamane mein Pajero ka culture tha, Nissan ka culture tha. Yeh un logon ko hum bechenge jo Pajeron mein baithte hain, safar karte hain aur Nissan mein safar karte hain. Kyunki jab aap kisi ko jute bechenge to wo kahega hai to jute, iska to koi faida hi nahi hai. Aur agar uske upar gold-plated button laga hua hai to ek mazdoor ko agar aap pehna denge, jo ki mazdoor ko hi suit karta hai, boriyan uthata hai, to uske liye wo uski value zero ho jayegi.

Lekin wahi cheez agar koi affluent aur ek rich aadmi aur ek facilities wala banda pehen ke niklega to uske liye wo ek status symbol ban jayega. So this is how I took a start in my entrepreneurial journey. Achha, wo humne koi banayi aur 60-70 ke qareeb humne bech bhi di. Achha, theek hai, ab wahi log select karke aur wo... ab yeh wo unorthodox model tha jiske upar phir main kaam kar raha tha, ke yaar mere paas aur to koi model nahi hai, maine to model khud hi apna banana hai.

To main stock exchange ke andar meri ek phase aisi aayi ke mere walid sahab ne mujhe paise diye aur main, maine mujhe aur kuch samajh nahi aayi. Mere ek aur dost bade expert the, mere hi class fellow the, aur wo America mein, Wall Street mein kaam karke aaye the. Wahin se unhone MBA kiya tha, wapas aaye, unhone kaha, yaar tere paas paise hain? Unhone kaha, haan hain. To maine walid sahab se paise liye aur stock...

Yaani jitni investment humne ki hui thi, aur wo is had tak hum usmein ulajh gaye ke humein yeh samajh se bahar ho gaya ke paison ki kabhi kami bhi ho sakti hai, paise kabhi gaib bhi ho sakte hain. Yaani wo is tarah ka ek pattern set ho gaya, aur hum millions of rupees ki savings mein chale gaye. Till the time ki wo crash hui, aur maine apni original investment jo hai wo maine side pe kar li hui thi, lekin baaki saare paise jo maine earn kiye the wo doob gaye usmein. Aur ab uske baad mere paas paise nahi hain, aur mere walid sahab ne mujhe yeh kaha ke aaj tum chehre se pareshan nazar aa rahe ho, to main khamosh hoon. To unhone kaha ke yaar jo kuch bhi hai, If you have lost money,

just take care of one thing, nobody should come and knock the door. Kisi ke paise dene na hon, bas ek cheez ka khayal rakhna. Baaki paise jo aate hain wo chale jaate hain, phir aa jaate hain, to no worries. To mera, mujhe yaqeen tha ke maine kisi se paise nahi liye hue, aur maine kisi ke paise nahi dene, to wo, mere paas koi permanent income nahi hai aur kuch nahi. Ab main chonke unorthodox model ke upar hi tha, to phir maine shirts banayi, shirts bana ke bechni shuru ki. Us zamane mein bag, mere paas bag hi nahi tha. Mere father-in-law, ek bag unke paas, bag the, wo koi Iran se leke aaye the. Maine apni wife ko request ki, maine kaha, yeh in se mujhe ek bag le do. Bag, wo bag aisa tha, usmein aath-das shirts aa jaati thi. Plan mera kya tha ke shirts banayenge, pack karenge, aur office mein jaa ke unko introduce karwayenge aur deliver karenge aur customize karenge. Lo ji, wo kaam chal pada.

Lekin usko us tak pahunche, main to migraine ka aur headache ka patient, main to... To us zamane mein jab paise bhi aapki jeb mein na hon, aapko paidal safar karna pad raha hai aur aapka lifestyle wahi ho, suit-boot aapke paas hain, tieyan hain, joote hain, sab kuch hai, to main wo bechta tha aur phir usse kuch earning aati thi aur us earning se phir main apna guzara karta tha, ghar mein paise deta tha. Is tarah se phir ghadiyan bechne wali ek company mil gayi, unhone kaha ji ke hum aapko yahan pe chhodayenge, is bazaar mein aapne roz ki itni ghadiyan bechni hain aur usmein se aapko itna commission hum denge aur waghera waghera.

Yeh saari cheezein aur isi dauraan mujhe mera jo college, jis college se maine MBA kiya tha, unhone mujhe bula liya, invite kiya. Unhone kaha ji ke humein pata chala hai ke aap shirts bechte hain, aur yeh customized services ki badi khoobsurat example hai ke aap jaate hain, aap logon se taaruf karaate hain, kabhi kisi ne aaj tak shirt nahi bechi. Koi khilone bechta hai, koi toffiyan bechta hai, koi perfumes bechta hai, but shirt kabhi kisi ne nahi bechi. To aap aisa karenge, hamare na, yeh ek badge hai, uski class hai, usko koi 40 minute ka lecture dein, kyunki inko nahi samajh aati ke customized services kya hoti hain, and you are actually doing this. To wo maine phir wahan pe lecture bhi diya, mujhe badi khushi hui ke ji main is qabil hoon. Us waqt I was very young. To yeh saara ka saara jo experimental... Haan, wo aap bata rahe the van ke safar se leke... Haan, ChenOne... to dekhein na, van ke safar se leke jismein aap seedhe nahi khade ho sakte agar aapko seat na mile, aur phir aapki haalat itni ujad jaati hai ke aapko aadha ghanta, pauna ghanta lagta hai ke aap apne aap ko refresh kar sakein aur kahin pe presentable position mein aa sakein, kahin pe milne ke liye jaana hai.

To yeh karte karte ismein ups and downs aaye, kabhi zyada bik jaati thi shirts, kabhi kam bik jaati, but wo jo ek permanent income ka source hota hai na, jiski poori family ko requirement hoti hai, wo nahi tha. Phir finally mujhe kisi ne refer kiya, meri mother ne, hamare ek family friend the, meri mother ne unse zikr kiya, wo unhone kaha, haan ji, hum ChenOne mein aapko karte hain. Wo is tarah se karke mujhe ChenOne mein ek aasra lag gaya, ek ummeed lag gayi, ek hope aa gayi. Main janab udhar roz chala jaata tha, taiyaar hoke, har roz mujhe kehte the ji ke aaj Mian Sahab aa jayenge, aur wo aise karte karte teen mahine guzar gaye. Lekin Mian Sahab nahi aa rahe the. Mian Latif, such a great man, janab, group ke chairman, yaani wo mere mentor hain, mere wo leader hain, mere teacher hain, matlab main unki badi respect karta hoon, kyun unhone mujhe sikhaya.

Teen mahine jab main wahan jaata raha na, to last day, jis din, us din bhi mujhe nahi pata tha ke wo aayenge. Lekin us din meri haalat yeh thi ke Madras check, un dinon mein bada popular tha, uski shirt maine pehni hui hai, cotton ki wrinkled trouser pehni hui, jooton ki haalat ujad gayi hui, bag haath mein. To mujhe kehte hain ji ke Babur Ayub kidhar hai? Maine kaha ji, ji hoon, main roz khada ho jaata tha na wahan jaake. To unhone kaha ji ke wo Mian Sahab aa gaye hain, wo aapka interview hai. Main bada, yaani, sort of dejected person, ke achha yaar ab mil lete hain, ab matlab roz aa rahe hain, to Mian Sahab ko bhi mil lete hain. Yaani yeh attitude, aur wo ban gaya tha. Andar gaye, lamba sa conference hall, usmein ek Mian Sahab baithe hue, ek hamare general manager baithe hue, ek side pe unhone mujhe bitha diya.

Aur salaam dua karne ke baad unhone kaha ji, yeh, aap kya kar sakte hain, aap kya kaam kar sakte hain? To maine briefcase khola, usi mood mein, usmein se maine koi, koi 50 ke qareeb to mere paas wo thi, reports thi. Maine aise table pe rakhi. Sir, yeh aapke shirts ka analysis, sir, yeh aapki trousers ka analysis, sir, yeh aapki ladies' garments ka, yeh, ye wo kehte hain, ek minute thehro. To yeh kaam aap kab karte rahe? Maine kaha sir, mujhe teen mahine se main idhar aa raha hoon, aur shuru mein main bade achhe dress mein aata tha, phir ab aakhir mein main mayoos ho gaya, maine kaha pata nahi aap aate hain, nahi aate hain, aap exist bhi karte hain ya nahi karte. To main, maine socha ke mere paas opportunity hai, main aapke product analysis kar deta hoon. To maine aapki almost 99% products ka analysis karke rakha hua hai.

To unhone wo general manager ko kaha ke yeh banda aapne kahan se source kiya hai? Yeh khud ba khud kaam karta hai. Ab main usi tarah serious mood mein baitha hua hoon. Achha, to phir aap hamare liye kya karenge? Ab wo, main, saamne sheesha tha, sheeshe ke bahar guard nazar aa raha tha. To maine kaha sir, agar aap mujhe guard rakh lein is company mein, to aapki sales badh jayengi. Kehte, kaise badh jayengi, guard rakhne se, kaise sales ka to kaam andar hai. Maine kaha sir, aap mujhe guard rakhenge, usko English bolni nahi aati, main kuch English bol leta hoon. Main jab aapke guest ko welcome karunga, unko greetings karunga, salaam dua karunga, to they will get good impression. Kahenge, pata nahi kis gore ki company Pakistan mein aa gayi hai, to aapki sales to badh jayengi. Wo, matlab, unhone trembling ke saath, unhone kaha, yaar ek minute thehro, ek minute thehro. I don't know ke tum kya kaam karoge, lekin yeh mujhe pata hai ke tum meri team ka hissa ban gaye ho. Main usi tarah se baitha hua tha, usi mood mein baitha hua tha. To...

Phir main baqaida unki shagirdi mein chala gaya, aur wo saara... aur maine, phir mujhe yeh achhi tarah se yaad hai ke... Just after a span of nine months, I was raised to the position of Operations Head Pakistan in the same company. Ab baat yeh batane wali hai ke main nahi jaanta tha ke maine kya aisa kiya jo inko suit karta tha aur wo meri tarakki ka ya meri promotion ka baais ban gaya. Jabke bohat saare aur log zyada talented honge, unko market se bhi mil sakta aur... jo ke typical way mein wo nahi dekh sakte. Mera khayal hai ke mujhe, maine wahan pe apni marzi se, jo main sochta tha ke agar maine customer ko tackle karna hai to kaise karna hai.

Ke maine agar yeh customer trouble kar raha hai to maine usko handle kaise karna hai. Kyunki complaints aati hain na, badi customer complaints bohat aati hain. Mujhe yaad hai ke ek dafa ek complaint aayi, to main, koi mujhe koi ek hafta ya 10 din hue the floor ko manage karte hue, to ek khatoon thi, umar raseeda, unhone kisi se poocha ke tumhara manager kidhar hai? To wo jo team thi, unhone meri taraf refer kiya. Main front desk pe hi customers ko dekh raha hota tha, salaam dua karta tha. Unka wo manager hai. Unhone meri taraf dekha aur unhone kaha ke tujhe pata nahi ke main kaun hoon.

Unhone Punjabi mein bola ke tujhe pata nahi main kaun hoon, [unclear], te je main unhon das dita nahi, te unhon chhedna nahi. Main ab khada hoon udhar aise karke na, uske peeche. Unhone apne bag mein se joota nikala hai, ladies' joota tha, aur unhone throw kiya meri taraf. Ab, ab, I mean, ek embarrassment ko ek humour mein convert karne ka, wo mera pehla experience tha.

Main neeche baith gaya, aur wo joota peeche jaa ke kisi frame pe laga. Main phir khada ho gaya. To mujhe kehti hain ke tum bach gaye ho. Phone milao. Wo ladke ne phone milaya, baat ki. Kehti, mera beta hai, isse baat karo. Maine us phone pe baat ki, ji, salaam walekum.

Kehte hain, tusi manager gal kar rahe ho? Main ji. Tusi ghabrana nahi, asi aap bade ghabraye hoye hain, yeh is tarah kar dende ne. Unhone pistol waghera da zikar si, main bada dara hua hoon. Maine unko samjhaya ke ji main us din jo tha, wo ghalti se maine kiya tha, wo ghalti se ho gaya tha, wo main... Ab wo khatoon khush ho rahi hain ke yeh dara hua hai. To unhone kaha ji, bas aap inko replacement dein, aur bade ba-izzat tareeqe se inhein kahein ke ji main bilkul dar gaya hoon aur main aainda aise nahi karunga. Wo maine unko yahi bataya. I mean, yeh jo, yeh jo saare experiences the...

Ismein ek Pakistan ki bohat badi seller company hai, jiske, jiske CEO the, abhi main us company ka naam nahi loonga, one of the biggest seller company, mobile phones hain unke, connections hain. Wo subah store open hote hi wo sahab aaye, aur unhone kaha ke yeh tie aap dekh rahe hain? Maine wo tie dekhi. To maine kaha ji, sir, yeh hamara brand hai. Unhone kaha, achha, aur kuch aapne nahi dekha iske upar? Maine kaha ji... kaha, yes... Maine yeh kal raat ko Islamabad ke aapke branch se purchase kiya hai. Subah main jahaz pe baitha hoon. 20 minutes ki meri flight thi, aur yeh dekh rahe hain aap, raising.

To main bewakoofi mein ya... maine unhein yeh keh diya ke yeh raising, sir, wo koi ragad waghera lag gayi hai, kahin rub kiya hai aapne use. Tumhein pata nahi hai ke kis tarah se baat karte hain customer ke saath, main isko rub karunga. Maine to purchase ki hai. Ab wo, unhone kaha ke main to aapko CEO se baat karunga. Unhone hamare CEO se baat ki. Hamare CEO ne kaha ke main dekh leta hoon.

Wo chale gaye naraaz hoke, unhone kaha ke agar aap jaise bande inhone manager rakhe hue hain to iska matlab hai yeh company doobne wali hai. Yaani is tarah ki baatein karke gaye mujhe. To mere CEO jo the, hamare, unhone mujhe call ki, unhone kaha ke yaar hum pe aapka impression yeh hai ke aap gadhe aur ghode dono ke saath baat kar sakte hain. Aap mein badi capacity hai. To yeh hua kya hai? Maine kaha sir, yeh ek mujhse ghalti hui hai, jo ke shayad maine usse learn bhi kar liya hai.

Unhone kaha, achha, maine kaha, sir, mera khayal hai ke maine jo usko kaha tha, wo shayad ghalti thi. Customer is the king, and when he's showing me the complaint and he's showing me the quality of the product, I should have not said him, ke sir, yeh aapne rub kiya hoga, aur mujhe usko replacement deni chahiye thi. Uske baad phir maine unko koi chaar ghante ke baad apologize kiya.
